newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thailand decides to leave tin grouping.
newsitem.headline: Thailand decides to leave tin grouping.

text.p: Thailand's cabinet has approved the country's withdrawal from the Kuala Lumpur-based Association of Tin Producing Countries (ATPC), a government official said on Wednesday.
The withdrawal would become effective on October 1 this year, she told Reuters.
Thailand's departure from the grouping was widely expected.
The move to leave was prompted by Thailand's position as a net importer of the metal and its dissatisfaction over the group's failure to stabilise world tin prices, industry sources said.
They added that Thai miners produced less tin because many had been forced out of business by falling prices.
In 1995, Thailand imported 7,368 tonnes of concentrates and produced 1,783 tonnes domestically.
